claims.evidence: Witness report shows Nikon-branded boxes and a Nikon camera/lens setup on packaging inserts, but the exact model text (D750) is not readable in the provided observations.
No clear close-up photos of the camera body condition (scratches/dents) or lens/sensor clarity were shown.
No test photos/videos or evidence of autofocus/zoom/button/port functionality were shown.

claims.claim: We have the model is D750
claims.evidence: The witness could not read the exact camera model/series from the photos; D750 is not confirmed by readable text in the report.

risks.risk: Model mismatch (not actually Nikon D750 body; could be another Nikon DSLR or a kit with different lens/body).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the camera body model marking (e.g., 'D750') and the lens model name/number, plus a close-up of the box label showing 'D750'.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR body/unknown model (worst-case: lower value than D750).

risks.risk: Not a complete kit (missing battery, charger, strap, cables, lens hood, manuals, or other accessories).
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing every included item (battery, charger, cables, strap, lens/hood, caps, manuals) with labels visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only with missing accessories (worst-case: no charger/battery).

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches/dents, worn buttons/ports, damaged mount, foggy lens elements).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the camera body front/back, lens mount area, and lens glass at an angle showing haze/fungus/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible cosmetic wear (worst-case: noticeable marks).

risks.risk: Sensor or optical problems (dead pixels, haze, fungus, scratches on sensor/lens).
risks.proof: A test shot of a blank wall at high ISO plus a close-up of the lens front element; optionally a sensor cleaning/inspection photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially needing service/cleaning (worst-case: reduced image quality).

risks.risk: Functional problems (autofocus/zoom not working, shutter issues, image stabilization issues, ports/viewfinder problems).
risks.proof: Short video showing power-on, menu navigation, autofocus lock on a moving subject, and a burst of shots; include a playback shot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully verified working (worst-case: may require repair).

risks.risk: Shutter count/usage unknown (high wear reduces value).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera showing shutter count (or EXIF/utility readout) and a clear view of the camera serial/model plate.

risks.risk: Authenticity/warranty uncertainty (counterfeit parts or non-original packaging; warranty/receipt not verifiable).
risks.proof: Photos of the serial number plate and any receipt/warranty documents; close-up of box label/serial match.
risks.if_unproven: Price without warranty/receipt assurance (worst-case: no authenticity proof).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera body showing 'D750' model text and the serial number plate.
Photo of the lens model name/number (if a lens is included) and the lens mount area.
A full inventory laid out: battery, charger, cables, strap, lens hood/caps, manuals/inserts—everything included.
Close-up photos of the camera body for scratches/dents and the lens glass for haze/fungus/scratches.
A short working test video: power on, menu, autofocus lock on a moving subject, and a burst of photos.
A shutter count screenshot/readout (or EXIF/utility output) and a sample high-ISO test shot of a blank wall.
response.reason: The witness confirms Nikon-branded packaging and a camera/lens setup, but the exact D750 model and working/condition details are not verifiable from the provided observations. To price safely in Oyo, Nigeria, we need proof of the model and a basic functionality/condition test.
